details.label: INCORRECT
details.reasoning: The gold target is 2, while the predicted answer is 97.9%. These are materially different percentages, so the prediction contradicts the target.
details.groundedness_reasoning: 1. Citation [5] gives 97.9% of the world population covered by at least 2G in 2024. 2. Citation [1] gives 96% covered by 3G or above and explains that the technology values are incremental. 3. Subtracting 96% from 97.9% gives 1.9% covered by 2G but not a more advanced network, which rounds to the gold target of 2%.
